svg.title: Median heuristic burden gaps
svg.desc: Family A cells use exact finite optima; Family B cells use exactly rechecked HiGHS-optimal references. Evidence classes are not pooled.
svg.text: Family A cells use exact finite optima; Family B cells use exactly rechecked HiGHS-optimal references. Evidence classes are not pooled.
Color spans the full observed median-gap range 0 to 3.583. NA is unavailable, never zero.
